title: Longest run without a repeat
description:
A fraud team looks at the sequence of pages a session visits, encoded as one character per page. They want the longest stretch in which no page was visited twice.

Write `longest_unique_run(pages)` that returns the length of the longest contiguous substring with no repeated character.

**Example**

```
longest_unique_run("abcabcbb")   # 3   ("abc")
longest_unique_run("pwwkew")     # 3   ("wke")
```
hints: Keep a window `[start, end]` that never contains a repeat.
Remember the last index where you saw each character in a dict.
When the current character was last seen inside the window, jump `start` to just past that index. Be careful not to move `start` backward.
